# ExampleSaaS

> ExampleSaaS (https://www.example.com) is an enterprise workflow automation platform for engineering and DevOps teams, providing event-driven CI/CD orchestration, audit logging, and native MCP integrations.

ExampleSaaS offers transparent self-serve and enterprise plans:
- **Starter ($49/month)**: Up to 5 seats, 10,000 workflow runs/month, GitHub & Slack integrations.
- **Pro ($199/month)**: Up to 25 seats, 100,000 workflow runs/month, RBAC, audit logs, and REST/MCP API access.
- **Enterprise (Custom)**: Unlimited seats, SAML/OIDC SSO, SOC 2 Type II report, dedicated VPC peering, and 99.99% SLA.

## Core Product & Platform

- [Platform Overview](https://www.example.com/platform): Architecture, execution guarantees, and supported cloud providers.
- [Pricing & Plan Comparison](https://www.example.com/pricing): Monthly and annual billing tiers, usage quotas, and enterprise add-ons.
- [Security & Compliance](https://www.example.com/security): SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, data residency, and encryption specifications.

## Documentation & Developer Tools

- [Quickstart Guide](https://www.example.com/docs/quickstart): Deploy your first workflow in 5 minutes via CLI or Terraform.
- [REST API Reference](https://www.example.com/docs/api): OpenAPI 3.1 endpoints, authentication, and rate limits.
- [MCP Server Integration](https://www.example.com/docs/mcp): Connect ExampleSaaS to Claude Desktop, Cursor, and VS Code.
- [Changelog](https://www.example.com/changelog): Versioned product releases and breaking-change notices.

## Comparisons & Benchmarks

- [ExampleSaaS vs. Legacy CI Runners](https://www.example.com/compare/legacy-ci): Cold-start latency, caching throughput, and total cost of ownership.
